title: How a Pressure Washer Works in 60 Seconds 💦⚙️ #shorts
description:
A garden hose delivers roughly 50 PSI, but a home pressure washer can reach about 3,000. A motor drives small pistons that squeeze the water, and a tiny nozzle turns it into a fast, narrow jet. When you release the trigger, an unloader valve sends the water back around the pump. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#pressurewasher #cleaning #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: A garden hose gives about *50 PSI*. A home pressure washer can hit about *3,000*.

steps.label: Pump
steps.text: Hose water flows into a *pump*, driven by an electric motor or a gas engine.

steps.label: Pistons
steps.text: Inside, a tilted *wobble plate* pushes small *pistons* that squeeze the water in rapid pulses.

steps.label: Nozzle
steps.text: At the end of the wand, a tiny *nozzle* forces the water out as a fast, thin jet.

steps.label: Tips
steps.text: Swap the tip to change the spray: *narrow* for power, *wide* for gentle cleaning.

steps.label: Unloader
steps.text: Let go of the trigger, and an *unloader valve* sends the water back around the pump.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Pump, squeeze, *blast*. Follow Inside 60 for more.
